## Objective and scope

Replay the frozen candidate from a clean environment and independently recompute the admission decision.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Reproduce representative successes and all failure classes, verify complete archive/input/source identities, and independently recompute all aggregate and confidence-interval decisions.
2. Check inclusion rules, subject overlap, reference validity, cohort/tail outcomes and exact geometry contracts; verify no selected-case or missing-map bias in claims.
3. Publish a signed/versioned decision receipt distinguishing completed evaluation, experimental ledger admission and competitive qualification. Sampling is not a global diffeomorphism proof.
4. On failure, preserve the failed qualification, mark its subjects observed, keep G5 open and create a specific remediation/new-confirmation plan; do not relabel development or waive the threshold.

## Planned areas

- docs/benchmarks/
- benchmarks/flashalign/verification helpers
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md

## Blocking prerequisites

- Q03 (`bd-01M4X4DZSH4T8JPYC8MQQ1HAXZ`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
